title: External products of space presheaves commute with product Kan extensions
statement:
Use the quasicategories, coherent functor categories and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], spaces from [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], and the left Kan extensions with their specified units from [lem-coef-infinity-space-valued-pointwise-lan]. Let $I$ be a finite set, let $A_i,B_i$ be small infinity categories, $h_i:A_i\to B_i$ coherent functors and $F_i:A_i^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S$ space-valued presheaves. Put $P(A)=\operatorname{Fun}(A^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$ and define $\boxtimes_iF_i\in P(\prod_iA_i)$ by $(a_i)\mapsto\prod_iF_i(a_i)$, using the finite product in spaces. Write $(h_i)_!$ for left Kan extension along $h_i^{\mathrm{op}}$. The natural comparison specified by the external product of the Kan units is an equivalence
$$\left(\prod_i h_i\right)_!\left(\boxtimes_iF_i\right)\simeq\boxtimes_i(h_i)_!F_i.$$
This equivalence is natural in the functors, presheaves and their coherent transformations, preserves the specified Kan units, and is compatible with regrouping finite products and composition of the $h_i$, including higher simplices. For $I=\varnothing$, both indexing categories are terminal and the external product is the terminal presheaf. No nonemptiness of comma categories or filteredness assumption is required. All input categories and values are small in a fixed universe; functor categories are formed in a larger one.
